title: A bill to designate the facility of the United States Postal Service located at 1765 Camp Hill Bypass in Camp Hill, Pennsylvania, as the "John Charles Traub Post Office".
official_summary: This act designates the facility of the U.S. Postal Service located at 1765 Camp Hill Bypass in Camp Hill, Pennsylvania, as the John Charles Traub Post Office.

summary.headline: A federal law renames a Postal Service facility in Camp Hill, Pennsylvania, as the John Charles Traub Post Office.
summary.what_it_does: This act gives a official name to the U.S. Postal Service facility at 1765 Camp Hill Bypass in Camp Hill, Pennsylvania. The building will be called the John Charles Traub Post Office. It does not change how the post office operates or what services it offers.
summary.when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted on November 25, 2024.
